decisions.reason: Changing the source for author photos does not alter the requirement to request supplemental images when needed for layout balance.
The URL identifies the correct author-photo source and does not change the polished, modern, WBEdition-aligned visual style requirement.
Correcting the author-photo source does not change the digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
Selecting the correct author photos from the supplied page does not modify the separate requirement to enhance image quality when needed.
The author-photo correction does not change the digital launch target or deadline.
The author-photo URL is unrelated to flipbook hosting cost or platform selection.
